subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding borrowing at a basic level: sometimes people borrow money and have to pay it back, often with a little extra
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a simple borrowing scenario (borrowing play money from a 'bank' and paying back more than borrowed)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a borrowed amount to the total that must be paid back, including a little extra
exercise.abstract: Student explains why paying back a loan usually means paying back more than what was borrowed

misconception_flags: believes a borrowed amount is always paid back as exactly the same amount, with no extra

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
